Name: Crystal Lamps
Author: coledoesntexist
Description:
[u]There're 7 lamps in total including:[/u]
   - Helvite Lamp
   - Orpiment Lamp
   - Calcite Lamp
   - Emerald Lamp
   - Ghost Crystal Lamp
   - Amethyst Lamp
   - Dolomite Lamp
All 7 lamp recipe's can be bought from the Dwarf

[u]Each lamp uses their respective crystal to power it up:[/u]
   - Helvite Lamp = Helvite
   - Orpiment Lamp = Orpiment
   - Calcite Lamp = Calcite
   - Emerald Lamp = Emerald
   - Ghost Crystal Lamp = Ghost Crystal
   - Amethyst Lamp = Amethyst
   - Dolomite Lamp = Dolomite
[u]
[/u][b][u]Installation[/u][/b]
   - Make sure you have all the required mods downloaded
   - Download this mod
   - Extract the folder
   - Drag and drop the extracted folder into your mods folder

[url=http://ko-fi.com/coledoesntexist]Feel free to support me by buying me a Ko-fi :)[/url]
